page.overview:
Who is Piersall?

Lieutenant junior grade Piersall was a 24th century Human Starfleet command division officer serving aboard the in 2370.

That year, he assisted Gideon Seyetik with the project of reigniting the long dead star, Epsilon 119. He warned Seyetik that he'd be killed, to which Seyetik suggested he record his actions for posterity. When Seyetik mentioned The Fall of Kang and not wishing to be pitied, Piersall didn't understand the reference. ()
